country_decisions: CFG-PAS-001: passport and travel document types and eligibility (none ship).
CFG-PAS-002: validity, replacement, cancellation and custody rules (none ship); fees only from the approved schedule passports.fees.

library.title: Return or surrender a travel document
library.intro: Record a document returned or surrendered: the receipt and where it is held.
library.filled_by: An official of the travel document authority, signed in.
library.authority: The travel document authority the nation names for the travelDocuments slot (authorityFor('travelDocuments'), shipped empty; it may be the immigration authority). Never a ministry by name.

policies.access.read_rule: canReadTravelDocuments() in lib/auth/roles.ts: the travel document authority's officials with a stated purpose; every read in the access log
policies.access.others: Other institutions learn only whether a document is valid through travel-document.status, never the file

deviations.what: The seven minimisation answers per field (Part 1 §1.6) are not in the library contract: they are given with the procedure package the nation approves and recorded in the data and privacy review (a human publication gate)
deviations.why: Question 2 (the provision that authorises collection) is the nation's law; a library draft cannot answer it. No form is approved without the review.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md forms: publication is lib/forms/publication.ts (human approvals by different signed-in officials)

deviations.what: Each evidence item names its kind and when it is needed; the civicos.evidence-requirement.v1 record that ties it to a provision of law is made with the nation's procedure package
deviations.why: The legal basis of evidence is the nation's; until it is cited the evidence gate does not pass.

deviations.what: Scanning, OCR, USSD/SMS and offline field capture are not on the platform: a paper form is transcribed by an official and the case records that it came on paper and who transcribed it
No field scores a person, a household, a credential, an employer or an application: no risk, credibility, propensity or match score exists in the contract or its procedure
deviations.why: Directions §15.6 and §15.7; supplement Part 15: a risk score alone cannot determine loss of essential support; field series Part 4 §4.4: no opaque risk scores.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Immigration and Customs ("never a score"); lib/social/procedures.ts refuses a suspension whose grounds rest on a score

deviations.what: The travel document authority is the institution the nation names for the travelDocuments slot (it may be the immigration authority), shipped empty; until it is named no case opens
deviations.why: CFG-PAS-001 and specification Part 2 §C.4: a country may assign these functions to different institutions.

deviations.what: No biometric field, template, match or score: a photograph is a document of the case (an image), and no biometric template is made or stored
deviations.why: Field series Part 4 §3.4: biometric collection is not a default; CFG-IDN-004 (biometric authorisation) needs the nation's law and an independent legal review first (plan I11).
deviations.rule: lib/identity/register.ts and lib/passports/register.ts hold no biometric data; app/scripts/requirements/catalogue.py PROHIBITED_FIELD

quotes: ICAO Doc 9303 provides international specifications for machine-readable travel documents.
Use its applicable parts for document formats and validation, while keeping national issuance law, eligibility and decision-making rules separately configurable.

platform.how: ICAO_ELEMENTS: the ICAO Doc 9303 data elements of each document; issuance law, eligibility and decisions stay the nation's (procedures drafted, mappings unapproved)

quotes: Passports and other travel documents require their own issuance, security, validity, and replacement workflows.
The exact documents and eligibility rules must be configured by country.

platform.how: passport.application, passport.status and passport.review: issuance, security (production, quality, custody), validity and replacement; document types are the nation's list

quotes: Passport numbers and security-sensitive production data must not be broadly searchable by staff without a specific authorized purpose.

platform.how: A document number is searched only with a stated purpose, by the travel document authority; every search and refusal in the access log

quotes: Lost-document reporting must not be treated as conclusive proof of fraud.
The authorized process determines the status of the old document and whether a replacement is permitted.

platform.how: A lost or stolen report sets the document reported, not cancelled; cancellation and replacement are decided in a case with reasons

quotes: A refusal or revocation must follow the applicable legal procedure and authorized human decision.
The platform should support reasons, notice, review, and appeal where required; it must not invent those rights or remove them through generic workflow defaults.

platform.how: Refusal and revocation are four-eyes decisions with reasons and the review route; revocation follows notice and representations; a review is by officials who took no part
